propositions: Hardcoded src/rebar file scan and .github/module-size-limit.txt cap file must be removed from git_metrics and replaced with config-driven [code_health] settings

Size metrics must use scc LOC analyzer (scc_loc.analyze) via new _analyzer_spec adapter to compute module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count, returning Unavailable when analyzer unavailable instead of fabricated zeros

module_size_distribution must calculate count, max_loc, over_cap_count, and near_cap_count (files in band [size_cap*(1-size_near_fraction), size_cap] inclusive) from LOC payload; oversized_module_count must return count of files exceeding size_cap or None when uncapped
cap_change_events metric must be deregistered; module_size_trend seed must remain as Unavailable stub; oversized_module_count seed stub must be removed so only the analyzer-derived spec exists

Context in _commands/metrics.py must be extended to carry scan_roots, size_cap, size_near_fraction from [code_health] config and pass to analyzer; analyzer-derived specs must carry source="structural", lens="code_health", accruing_since="2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
Existing git_metrics tests must be updated; foreign (non-Python) repos must receive Unavailable honestly instead of zeros when analyzer is unconfigured
